name: Mud Dauber
desc: Mud Dauber (Sceliphron caementarium): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Sceliphron caementarium, also known as the yellow-legged mud-dauber wasp (within the US) or black-waisted mud-dauber wasp (outside of the US), is a species of sphecid wasp.
